info.title: navlyn-mcp
info.description: Read-only MCP server for Navlyn semantic C#/.NET evidence workflows.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: .slnx, .sln, or .csproj path, or auto to discover one.

options.name: --navlyn-executable
options.description: Navlyn CLI command or executable. Defaults to navlyn.

options.name: --navlyn-arg
options.description: Prefix argument for local dev, repeatable.

options.name: --max-json-chars
options.description: Max CLI stdout JSON chars. Defaults to 4000000.
